tool_args.rationale: Fit the verified siphon base with a numerically estimated signed square-root branch and use fresh confirmation to test its predictive accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations identify the three-parameter smooth square-root branch, so confirmation is more economical.
Pilot gradients are below the specified supercritical gray zone; its threshold and strength are not identified by these observations.
The supplied signatures and matched subtree favor the gradient-dependent siphon mechanism.
